title: Micro-footprint Illuminator: pricing & export lens for per-message economics
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Design a compact, exportable 'Micro-footprint Illuminator' view in Redwood Console that lets engineers and finance teams inspect per-message and per-session token economics, simulate pricing slabs, and export role-aware line-items for billing reconciliation. The view should scale from single-route debugging to multi-project aggregation and integrate with existing Console rollouts and cost dashboards.
scope:
- Primary surface: Compact lens panel available from Route / Model dashboards and the global Cost page.
- Key metrics: per-invocation token breakdown (prompt/response/system), embeddings units, KV cache hits, batch efficiency estimate, estimated unit cost (by SKU), and amortized model runtime cost.
- Features: interactive histogram + sankey for attribution, per-route filters, time-window selector, pricing-slab simulator, CSV/Parquet export with schema, and a small guided tour for first-time users.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Users can open the Micro-footprint panel from a route and see per-invocation breakdown within 200ms of panel load (server mocks accepted for prototype).
2) Export includes row-level fields: timestamp, route, model_version, invocation_id, role_tokens_{system,user,assistant}, response_tokens, embedding_units, cache_hit_boolean, cost_estimate_usd, pricing_slab_applied.
3) Pricing simulator lets users toggle a slab and preview delta in aggregate and per-invocation rows.
4) Visual attribution (sankey + sparkline) supports drill-to-filter and works on mobile widths.
5) Design reviewed and signed off by PM and Eng; accessibility contrast and keyboard nav pass internal audit.
design_decisions:
- Use compact table as primary surface with optional expanded row for token heatmap and payload preview.
- Sankey for attribution prioritized for quick insight on which role or prompt fragment drives cost; keep node count <= 6 to avoid visual noise.
- Default aggregation window = 24h with quick toggles for 1h, 7d, 30d.
- Exports must be schema-stable (versioned) to support downstream chargeback systems.
- Pricing simulator is local-only (client side) to avoid accidental billing changes; simulations are not applied to live billing.
open_questions: Should we include raw prompt text in exports or provide a redacted column to protect PII? (Privacy/Legal input required)
Do we need an explicit sampling control for high-throughput routes to limit exported rows?
usability_findings:
2025-02-18 session (n=6 engineers): users liked 'what-if' slider for quantization but wanted clearer indication of estimator confidence.
2025-02-25 prototype test (n=4 finance PMs): exports were validated against sample invoice lines; requested SKU mapping column and a summary header.
Action: add 'estimator_confidence' column and optional 'sku_map' toggle before export.
implementation_notes:
- Work with ENG on a lightweight telemetry endpoint to stream sample rows for prototyping (ENG-23456).
- CSV schema versioning: start with v0.1 and include a top-of-file metadata block in exports.
- Console components: extend existing DataTable and Sparkline primitives; create a new AttributionSankey component optimized for 60fps animations.
